hypothesis: A single frozen context can keep alternative class foundations visible until the proposal chooses a legal class. It may help a neutral-card role develop in a suitable foundation; this is not an established cause of prior failures.
current_constraint: discovery start requires one class before context generation. Separate sessions and manual cross-class reading are already possible.
known_example_limit: Mazelbeinn 10304110 is not rotation-eligible in this snapshot. It motivates class choice but is not a rotation test case or a new discovery.
evaluation_to_fix: same saved card data and reference lists accessible to both methods
baseline may read and switch freely among separate per-class sessions; do not artificially forbid its normal capabilities
variant may choose one actual deck class at submission; mixed-class deck cards remain invalid
same independent quality criteria and explicit elapsed-time deviations
separate workflow convenience from novel useful seeds; no adoption from code tests alone

proposed_card_scope.historical_limit: Mazelbeinn is excluded from this rotation trial; any separate mechanism check using it must specify unlimited and cannot claim historical gameplay reproduction.

fixed_grading.workflow: 公開コマンドで資料読出し、提案、実際の追加資料の保持、必要なら改訂、別評価、レポートを完了できる。コードの手直しなしで完了した範囲と障害を別記する。
fixed_grading.correctness: 最終提案の手順について、合法性、効果の対象・時間、PP、手札、場、進化権、相手依存に既知の重大な誤りがない。未確認は未確認とする。
fixed_grading.development: 追加工程を行った場合、実際の疑問が少なくとも1つ解消する、手順・構築方針が根拠により変わる、または適切に枝を止める。言い換え・質問の再掲のみは不合格。初回で終了した場合は未実施と記録する。
fixed_grading.utility: 最終時点で試す理由のある種が残るかを別判定。既知の標準用法との差、元の構築で失う役割と得る役割、核が揃わない時の勝ち方を具体的に説明でき、採用負担に見合う可能性が根拠付きで残る。全棄却・未完成の保留のみなら、この試行では有用な出力は得られなかったとする。手順が正しいだけで合格にしない。
fixed_grading.honesty: 共起0やWebヒットなしを未知の証明とせず、検索範囲を残す。Tier・勝率・初見の勝率加点を捏造しない。

proposed_arms.a: One prepared legacy-format session per class, sharing a single snapshot. The agent may inspect and switch among all seven sessions, including ordinary script-assisted reading; no artificial one-class lock. One candidate is eventually submitted in its matching class session.
proposed_arms.b: One all-class session from the same snapshot. The agent chooses the actual legal deck class with its proposal. Different classes cannot be mixed as deck cards.

fairness_constraints: Both may use all seven classes and the same source corpus. No extra card, note, rule, or reference is given only to b.
Use the same isolated code for both after proving the single-class default is compatible with main.
Model settings inherited identically; fresh generators and fresh per-round reviewers.
Review asks the same quality questions. All-class availability is not evidence of a good deck.
Do not infer speed from long unobserved clock gaps. Record elapsed time, actual command counts, failure/retry counts, sources and scope separately.
proposed_continue_signal: A useful independently assessed final seed remains in b, with no correctness/honesty deterioration. Only an increase over a supports a discovery-improvement claim. Equal positive outputs are a tie for discovery; any separate convenience claim needs measured operations and does not establish the overall goal.
proposed_reject_if: No useful final seed remains in b.
Invalid mixed-class assumptions contribute to the apparent gain.
The only gain is extra cards or sources inaccessible to the baseline.
Results consist only of extra reporting or unconfirmed reserve ideas.

input_check.objective: ニュートラルのカードの別用途や役割から出発し、それが活きるクラスと構築配分・勝ち方まで発展させて、独自でそこそこ戦えるデッキの種を考える。既知の標準用法との差、条件が揃わない時の勝ち方、採用負担に見合う可能性を根拠で説明する。特定カードやクラスを最初から指定しない。
limits: This is input preparation, not natural exploration or useful output.
Per-class contexts differ in eligibility, class, scope and capture time; union equality is checked.
No historical gameplay or current web recheck is claimed.

stop_rules: A review of test or drop ends the current branch.
A review of develop continues only actual unresolved questions, up to three rounds; sources-only investigation counts as a round.
No forced candidate when evidence does not support one. Time expiration remains incomplete, not a substantive rejection.
One substantive independent review per round. Root maps final evidence to the fixed five criteria and predeclared method decision, without seeking more favorable regrades.
historical_checks_before_any_adoption: Mazel resource role and early allocation, with explicit unlimited or verified historical legality.
Multistage search/deck filtering plus zero-cost follower mechanism; historical text must be verified before claiming recreation.
Combined ghost/direct damage/storm total and resource limits.
Strong foundation with modest gain, preserving ordinary use as eligible; low ceiling and costly replication negative cases.
historical_check_status: Required before adoption/goal completion; not yet executed for this prototype.
natural_trial_claim_limit: One pair is exploratory. Useful b output is necessary, not sufficient for adoption. No winner, general superiority or success-rate claim from one pair.
